title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 524, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of September, October, and November, 1985. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased to the Company. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 477. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
